ops.prevDaySetup: A reservation for day-before preparation (rehearsal) is possible depending on availability. The full usage fee is charged. Setup and cleanup must be done within the usage time. Changes to the layout and fixtures and equipment are accepted until noon on the business day before the usage date.
ops.loadingHours: For load-in using a hand truck, use the load-in elevator from B2F. A work notification must be submitted. The interior of the load-in elevator car is 1,900 mm wide x 1,800 mm deep x 2,300 mm high. From 1 business day before the usage date through the day itself, up to 3 cardboard boxes (guideline: about 25 x 35 x 20 cm high) are held free of charge (valuables, fragile items and food are not accepted; there is no delivery service afterward).
ops.vehicleRules: The maximum vehicle height allowed for load-in and load-out vehicles is 3.0 m. The parking entrance is on the Marunouchi 4th Street side.
ops.parking: There is a mechanical parking lot in the building's basement (height 2.0 m). 51 spaces for large vehicles: overall height under 2.0 m x length 5.3 m or less x width 1.95 m or less, weight 2.5 t or less. 21 spaces for medium vehicles: overall height under 2.0 m x length 5.0 m or less x width 1.95 m or less, weight 2.5 t or less.
ops.waitingRooms: Waiting rooms 1 and 2 (about 10㎡ each). Each is equipped with a 4-person meeting table, chairs, a full-length mirror, a storage shelf and a coat hanger. Waiting rooms cannot be reserved on their own; they are used together with Shibusawa Hall or the small and medium conference rooms. For meeting up, the Members Lounge (weekdays 10:00-17:00, drink order required) is recommended.
ops.catering: Outside food and drink may not be brought in, and partner caterers (Hashizen, Four Seasons, Shinkichi, Cordon Bleu, Tonkatsu Maisen, Ningyocho Imahan) are introduced. The food menu and quantities must be finalized by 1 week before the usage date. If you bring in PET bottle or paper carton drinks, the fee is 5,500 yen per 100 bottles (Additional Fee Schedule 2026.9). The fee for bringing in fixtures, equipment or items arranged by the user is 10% of the room fee. (The FAQ says outside food and drink are not accepted, while the Additional Fee Schedule sets a drink bring-in fee, so the description in the newer Additional Fee Schedule is also given)
